experiment: DCEC Journal Extension - CLIP ViT-B/16 Multi-Backbone Validation
purpose: Test whether frozen DCEC A3 behavior generalizes beyond CLIP ViT-B/32.

method.architecture_policy: Keep the same 512-dimensional A3 architecture used for ViT-B/32.

evaluation_policy.note: The previously opened Flickr30K final test must not be used for model selection, tuning, or iterative development of this backbone extension.

interpretation_guardrail: This experiment tests backbone generalization. It must not modify the permanently frozen ViT-B/32 A3 method.
